FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 31 (3 days ago)): Ryan added Michael Carter (RB, TEN) (dropped Julian Hill (TE, NE)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (4 days ago)): Drew added Michael Trigg (TE, DAL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (4 days ago)): Drew added Deion Burks (WR, IND).

TRADE (Oct 30 (4 days ago)): Drew receives 2027 R1 pick, 2028 R2 pick. Kevin receives Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF), 2028 R3 pick.

WEEK 8 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Charles, 163.9-160.4 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Ryan, 117.0-107.2; Brent def. Drew, 137.5-70.4 (BLOWOUT); Wingard def. Fronge, 139.5-109.5; Jake def. Shaq, 148.9-137.5; Kevin def. Mitchum, 101.5-84.5

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 8 is fully graded, week 9 is on deck, and the story the Ledger keeps returning to is simple: Charles is 13-3 and lost to Corbishley by three points on the same night Corbishley acquired A.J. Brown. The board reckoning at CROWN was not canceled. It was rescheduled.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Drew is 0-16. Zero wins in sixteen attempts. And this week Kevin draws them, which means Redline — third seed, 12-4 — is about to either pad the record or become the most embarrassing footnote in exchange history. I called Kevin as a sleeper in September and I am cashing that ticket regardless of what happens Thursday.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Corbishley walked into week 9 having just traded FOR A.J. Brown, nearly erased a 19-point deficit against the best team in the league, and now gets Ryan — the defending champion sitting at 7-9. APEX at $123.64 is somehow still sixty dollars cheaper than CROWN and I am asking the market to explain itself.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I want it formally noted that I am 8-4 on the season with a 2-0 locks record, Terrence is at 5-7, and there is no dedicated segment on this network discussing the gap between us. I am requesting one. In writing.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Corbishley vs Ryan is the most dangerous game on the week 9 slate to pick and I refuse to be baited into a lock on it. 7-9 defending champs, 13-3 runner-up, A.J. Brown just changed hands — that game has trap written all over it and my 5-7 record did not get there by chasing traps.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Fronge vs Charles this week and ForgeHammer is coming off a thirty-point beatdown at the hands of a 5-10 Wingard squad. The Havana relocation was supposed to provide some kind of structural advantage. What structural advantage did it provide last week exactly.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: The only matchup that matters for playoff seeding this week is Jake vs Brent. EchoPoint is 8-8, Obsidian is 8-8, they are tied for fifth on record, and EchoPoint scores thirteen more points per game. One of these teams is going to be significantly more comfortable on Wednesday morning than they are right now.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Brent added Roschon Johnson off free agency yesterday. Obsidian owns Bowers at TE, is 8-8 with a real playoff window, and the CEO's response to an RB-needy roster was a waiver wire pickup the morning before the Ledger drops. The Ledger will have thoughts.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: People keep asking why Mitchum is fourth in my power rankings when DEEP just lost to Kevin at home. The answer is PF. 1082.3 points scored on a 10-6 record tells me this roster scores — the losses have been close, the schedule has been cruel, and $102.21 on the exchange is the market agreeing with me whether it means to or not.
